title: Turbo Harness: Instance-Adaptive Harness Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2609.40330v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Automating the search for effective harnesses is an important step toward enabling agents to recursively self-improve. Existing harness optimizations typically produce a single global harness that is applied uniformly across task instances. However, a harness that works well on average may not be optimal for every instance. We introduce Turbo Harness, a framework that can adapt a globally optimized harness to each instance by reusing information generated during the original optimization process. Specifically, Turbo Harness recycles artifacts produced during a completed global harness optimization run, and summarizes them into a structured playbook. We train a harness editor to leverage this prior optimization experience to generate instance-specific patches to the global harness. translated_title: Turbo Harness：实例自适应的执行框架优化
translated_abstract: 自动化搜索有效的执行框架（harness）是实现智能体递归自我改进的重要一步。现有的执行框架优化方法通常只产生一个全局的执行框架，并将其统一应用于所有任务实例。然而，平均表现良好的执行框架未必对每个实例都是最优的。我们提出 Turbo Harness，这是一个通过复用原始优化过程中产生的信息，将全局优化的执行框架适配到每个实例的框架。具体而言，Turbo Harness 回收一次已完成的全局执行框架优化运行所产生的产物，并将其总结为结构化的“行动手册”（playbook）。我们训练一个执行框架编辑器，利用这些先前的优化经验为全局执行框架生成针对特定实例的补丁。在推理时，编辑器利用该实例和行动手册构建一个量身定制的执行框架，执行模型在其中运行。通过数值实验……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出 Turbo Harness 框架，通过回收全局执行框架优化过程中产生的信息构建结构化行动手册，并训练一个编辑器为每个任务实例动态生成定制的执行框架补丁，实现实例自适应的执行框架优化。
en_tdlr: Turbo Harness enables instance-adaptive harness optimization by recycling artifacts from a completed global optimization run into a structured playbook, and training a harness editor to generate instance-specific patches that tailor the harness at inference time.
